seo_title: Computer Science Scholarships for Women Without GPA Limits
seo_description: Explore 7 scholarships for women in computer science with no GPA requirement. Check deadlines and award amounts.
intro: Finding financial support for women pursuing degrees in computer science can be challenging, especially without GPA requirements. This selection includes 7 scholarships specifically designed for women in tech fields, with award sizes ranging from approximately $1,000 to $40,000. These opportunities not only alleviate financial burdens but also encourage women to thrive in STEM disciplines. As deadlines vary across listings, it’s wise to check them promptly.
